\f[facerival]\v[111]:\b...Tell me something.
\f[facerival]\bIs it true that Team Rocket has returned?
\f[facerival]\bWhat? You beat them? Hah!\nQuit lying.
\f[facerival]\bAre you serious?\nThen let's see how good you are.
\f[facerival]\v[111]:\b I hate the weak.
\f[facerival]\bPokémon, Trainers.\nIt doesn't matter who or what.
\f[facerival]\bI hate to see them hanging around. \nThat goes for Team Rocket, too.
\f[facerival]\bThey think they are big and though as long as they are in a group.
\f[facerival]\bBut get them alone, and they're weak.\nI hate them all.
\f[facerival]\bYou stay out of my way.\nYou won't be an exception if you get in my way.
